import pandas as pd

# Paths to source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_5/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_5/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_5/training_2.csv"

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source dataframes
df_union = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns have correct types as per target schema
# Target schema:
# ['fixed acidity': float, 'volatile acidity': float, 'citric acid': float, 'residual sugar': float,
#  'chlorides': float, 'free sulfur dioxide': int, 'total sulfur dioxide': int, 'density': float,
#  'pH': float, 'sulphates': float, 'alcohol': float, 'quality': int]

# Convert columns to target types explicitly
df_union['fixed acidity'] = df_union['fixed acidity'].astype(float)
df_union['volatile acidity'] = df_union['volatile acidity'].astype(float)
df_union['citric acid'] = df_union['citric acid'].astype(float)
df_union['residual sugar'] = df_union['residual sugar'].astype(float)
df_union['chlorides'] = df_union['chlorides'].astype(float)
df_union['free sulfur dioxide'] = df_union['free sulfur dioxide'].astype(int)
df_union['total sulfur dioxide'] = df_union['total sulfur dioxide'].astype(int)
df_union['density'] = df_union['density'].astype(float)
df_union['pH'] = df_union['pH'].astype(float)
df_union['sulphates'] = df_union['sulphates'].astype(float)
df_union['alcohol'] = df_union['alcohol'].astype(float)
df_union['quality'] = df_union['quality'].astype(int)

# Assign to target table name
Target3_5 = df_union

# Write the result to the specified path without the index column
Target3_5.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_5/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
